title: Koi in still water
excerpt: Quiet colour, a pond, and the patience of painting scales one by one.
body:
Koi are slow work. That is why I like them. The old Instagram drawings were often small and quick; this canvas asked me to sit longer.

Orange, cream, and a little peace. I wanted the water to feel still enough that you could hear it. Same heart as the cute animal sketches from @zradni_sarra — just more layers of paint.

Shown as painted. Nothing retouched for the blog.
